Two of our first campaigns that will be in this space are Angie Nixon for Senate and Anna V. Eskamani for Mayor! 

Join us to open this beautiful space this Saturday. 

frostforcongress.com/frosthq

Finding office space is difficult for campaigns, especially smaller ones. This space will give our endorsed candidates an opportunity to work out of a co-working space that has what they need to be successful. It will also be available to our Union friends + community orgs. I’M SO EXCITED.

I’m super excited to announce that we are opening a unique kind of space. Organizing Hub will be a year-round headquarters that will help campaigns no matter how big or small. It’s also be a community space where we plan to host artists, pop-ups, canvasses, rallies, and so much more.

I also have to say, I’m very proud of the coordination in Orange County. We’ve collectively built a machine focused on speaking to people year-round. From Rep. Eskamani to the DEC, our local unions, & other electeds, we work together, coordinate, and go all in for our candidates.

I’m proud that our entire local & statewide slate won last night. We work hard to ensure my endorsement isn’t just a co-sign. We dedicated real staff time, knocked doors, raised money, held public events, & did all we could. Proud of the team. Now to the general!
This is the ticket! Time to Organize every corner of this state. For a Florida that works for all of us. Let’s get to work. 💪🏾
